title: Base Format Sidecar (base.json)
description: Sidecar manifest enumerating the branches and tables present in a base-layer emit's run.duckdb. Defined by base-format.md, beside this schema.

base_format_version.description: Format version. v7 = 7. Reader gates on this; unknown versions must be rejected.

branches.description: Branches present in the emit, in branch tuple-lexicographic order.

tables.description: Tables present in run.duckdb, in DuckDB-catalog order.

runtime.description: Wallclock anchor for the run. Present only when the scenario declared a runtime calendar; omitted entirely otherwise.

pinned_ids.description: Pin identity surface. Present only when the run had pinned actors; omitted entirely otherwise.

enum_domains.description: Closed-domain registry for string properties (status / category typed properties and synthesized <kind>_type discriminators). Present only when the scenario declared at least one closed-domain string property; omitted entirely otherwise.

record_roles.description: Record-role taxonomy keyed by kind. Present when the emit contains at least one records-category table. The 'actor' entry is an object mapping each declared actor sub-type to its warehouse role ('dimension' or 'fact'); every other kind maps to a single role string. Keys sorted lexicographically. Omitted entirely when absent.

sub_type_columns.description: Per-sub-type declared-column partition for author-declared (schemas:) kinds. Present only when at least one partitioned kind's records table survives in this emit; omitted entirely otherwise.

presentation_keys.description: Per-kind key claims and key-space identity for presentation_id columns, derived from the kind's declared minting strategies (never author-asserted). Present only when at least one kind's presentation_id column mints; omitted entirely otherwise. Keys sorted lexicographically.

fork_path.description: @-joined fork path string for this branch.

parent.description: @-joined fork path of the parent branch, or null for a root (single-segment) branch.

slice_at.description: sim_time of the slice emitted for this branch.

start_datetime.description: ISO-8601 tz-aware datetime corresponding to sim_time = 0.

pinned_ids.description: Nested {<kind>: {<label>: <id-string>}}. Maps an author-declared (kind, label) pin to the id portion of the minted record id, equality-joinable against records__<kind>.record_id.

additionalProperties.description: Id portion of the record id minted for this (kind, label).

enum_domains.description: Nested {<kind>: {<property>: [<option>, ...]}}. Authoritative list of allowed string values for each closed-domain property. Keys at both levels are sorted lexicographically; option lists preserve declaration order.

additionalProperties.description: Allowed string values for this closed-domain property, in declaration order.

record_roles.description: Nested record-role taxonomy. Keys are kind names, sorted lexicographically. The 'actor' value is an object mapping sub-type name to role string; all other values are role strings.

oneOf.description: Role string for a non-actor, non-machinery records-category kind.
Per-sub-type role map for the 'actor' kind.

sub_type_columns.description: Nested {<kind>: {<sub_type>: [<column-name>, ...]}}. Keys at both levels sorted lexicographically. Per sub-type, the list of materialized column names (prop__<name>, plus ref_index__<name> for reference-typed properties; on a projected emit also presentation_id, prepended for every sub-type that declares an id strategy) declared by that sub-type, in the kind's union column order. May be an empty array for a sub-type whose declared properties are all collection-struct (the key is kept, never dropped).

additionalProperties.description: Per-sub-type column-name list map for one kind.
Materialized column names declared for this sub-type, in the kind's union column order.

category.description: Table category. 'fixed' tables (firings, history) have spec-defined columns. 'records' tables are parameterized per record kind. 'membership' tables project collection-struct property intervals.

record_kind.description: Record kind name. Required iff category=='records' or category=='membership'. Equals the middle component of name after 'records__' or 'membership__'.

property.description: Property name. Required iff category=='membership'. Equals the suffix of name after 'membership__<kind>__'.

type.description: DuckDB type literal. Producers using the recommended mapping (base-format.md) will use BIGINT, DOUBLE, BOOLEAN, VARCHAR, BLOB. Producers MAY use other DuckDB types as long as conformance C2 (DuckDB catalog matches sidecar) holds.

nullable.description: DuckDB column nullability. Optional. Omittable when consistent with the spec's nullability rules.

references.description: Record kind that this column points at, when the source schema declared a record-to-record reference. Present iff the column is a foreign-key projection: a single VARCHAR carrying the id portion of a record id, equality-joinable against records__<references>.record_id. Omitted for all other columns.

history_tracked.description: SCD class for records-category prop__<name> columns. true = type-2 (priors recoverable from the history table); false = type-1 (current value only). Present on every records-category prop__<name> column of a base_format_version: 7 emit, and on presentation-property columns. Omitted on structural, provenance, fixed-table, membership, and presentation_id columns.

temporal_class.description: Point-in-time semantics for records-category prop__<name> columns, derived by the producer from the property's declared schema (never author-declared). 'constant' = value never changes after creation; 'tracked' = value may change and every change is captured in the history table; 'slice_only' = value may change but changes are not captured in history (only the value as of the export slice is knowable). Present on exactly the same columns as history_tracked ('tracked' implies history_tracked: true, 'slice_only' implies history_tracked: false); a column carries history_tracked iff it carries temporal_class. Omitted on structural, provenance, fixed-table, membership, and presentation_id columns.

presentation_keys.description: Nested {<kind>: <flat_presentation_keys> | <partitioned_presentation_keys>}. One entry per kind whose presentation_id column mints; keys sorted lexicographically.

class.description: Key-space identity class of the minting declaration: 'counter' = per-declaration monotonic counter; 'record_index' = the parent row's record_index rendered verbatim or with a fixed prefix; 'uuid' = per-record RNG-minted UUID v4; 'record_id' = the row's own record id inherited verbatim.

prefix.description: Rendering prefix for digit-rendered classes ('counter' / 'record_index'); '' for the unprefixed (sequential / global) forms. Present iff class is digit-rendered.

width.description: Zero-pad width for digit-rendered classes; 0 for the unprefixed (sequential / global) forms. Present iff class is digit-rendered.

partition_key.description: One minting declaration's key claims, scoped to its partition.

unique_within.description: Uniqueness scope of this declaration's non-NULL values. 'emit' = distinct across every row of the table, even in a multi-branch emit; 'branch' = distinct among rows sharing a fork_path. Always present at partition scope (unlike the kind rollup, where the claim can be absent).

branch_stable.description: Whether the same record carries the same non-NULL value on every branch where it appears -- the cross-branch counterfactual join key. Present as a pair with slice_stable.

slice_stable.description: Whether a record keeps its non-NULL value across emits produced from the same producing run and the same producer configuration, regardless of slice or branch selection. Present as a pair with branch_stable.

flat_presentation_keys.description: A flat kind's block entry: the single declaration's claims.

partitioned_presentation_keys.description: A partitioned kind's block entry: per-sub-type claims plus a whole-column rollup.

sub_types.description: Per-sub-type key claims, keyed by declared sub-type name (sorted lexicographically). One entry per sub-type whose declared strategy mints (inherit sub-types included); zero-row partitions included; sub-types with no declaration are absent.

unique_within.description: Whole-column uniqueness rollup, derived from the union-safety algebra applied pairwise over the kind's entries. Omitted entirely when the algebra derives no claim -- absence is 'no claim', not 'not unique'.

branch_stable.description: Whole-column rollup: true iff every entry is stable-class, regardless of union safety.
